Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Object, tf As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    With ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 100, 50, 120, 60): .Name = "R": .TextFrame.Characters.Text = "Hi": End With
    With ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(msoTextOrientationHorizontal, 250, 50, 120, 60): .Name = "T": .TextFrame.Characters.Text = "Hi": End With
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        
    Case 1
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.MarginLeft = 10
    Case 2
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.MarginTop = 3.5
    Case 3
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.MarginRight = 0
    Case 4
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.MarginBottom = 20
    Case 5
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.MarginLeft = -1
    Case 6
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.MarginLeft = 10: tf.AutoMargins = True
    Case 7
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.AutoMargins = False
    Case 8
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.AutoMargins = True: tf.MarginTop = 2
    Case 9
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignCenter
    Case 10
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignRight
    Case 11
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignLeft
    Case 12
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignJustify
    Case 13
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignDistributed
    Case 14
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignGeneral
    Case 15
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = 5
    Case 16
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.VerticalAlignment = xlVAlignCenter
    Case 17
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.VerticalAlignment = xlVAlignBottom
    Case 18
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.VerticalAlignment = xlVAlignTop
    Case 19
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.VerticalAlignment = xlVAlignJustify
    Case 20
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.VerticalAlignment = xlVAlignDistributed
    Case 21
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.VerticalAlignment = 5
    Case 22
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 1
    Case 23
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 2
    Case 24
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 3
    Case 25
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 4
    Case 26
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 5
    Case 27
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 6
    Case 28
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 7
    Case 29
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = -4171
    Case 30
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = -4170
    Case 31
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = -4166
    Case 32
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = -4128
    Case 33
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalOverflow = xlOartHorizontalOverflowClip
    Case 34
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalOverflow = xlOartHorizontalOverflowOverflow
    Case 35
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalOverflow = 2
    Case 36
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.VerticalOverflow = xlOartVerticalOverflowClip
    Case 37
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.VerticalOverflow = xlOartVerticalOverflowEllipsis
    Case 38
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.VerticalOverflow = xlOartVerticalOverflowOverflow
    Case 39
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.VerticalOverflow = 3
    Case 40
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.ReadingOrder = xlRTL
    Case 41
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.ReadingOrder = xlLTR
    Case 42
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.ReadingOrder = xlContext
    Case 43
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.ReadingOrder = 5
    Case 44
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: s = tf.AutoMargins
    Case 45
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.AutoMargins = True: s = tf.AutoMargins
    Case 46
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = 7
    Case 47
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignCenter: tf.ReadingOrder = xlRTL
    Case 48
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 2: tf.Orientation = 1
    Case 49
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.ReadingOrder = xlRTL: tf.ReadingOrder = xlLTR
    Case 50
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.VerticalOverflow = xlOartVerticalOverflowOverflow: tf.MarginLeft = 10: tf.Orientation = 2: tf.VerticalAlignment = xlVAlignBottom: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignCenter
    Case 51
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("R").TextFrame: tf.VerticalOverflow = xlOartVerticalOverflowOverflow: tf.VerticalOverflow = xlOartVerticalOverflowClip
    Case 52
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.MarginLeft = 10
    Case 53
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.MarginTop = 3.5
    Case 54
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.MarginRight = 0
    Case 55
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.MarginBottom = 20
    Case 56
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.MarginLeft = -1
    Case 57
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.MarginLeft = 10: tf.AutoMargins = True
    Case 58
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.AutoMargins = False
    Case 59
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.AutoMargins = True: tf.MarginTop = 2
    Case 60
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignCenter
    Case 61
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignRight
    Case 62
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignLeft
    Case 63
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignJustify
    Case 64
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignDistributed
    Case 65
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignGeneral
    Case 66
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = 5
    Case 67
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.VerticalAlignment = xlVAlignCenter
    Case 68
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.VerticalAlignment = xlVAlignBottom
    Case 69
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.VerticalAlignment = xlVAlignTop
    Case 70
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.VerticalAlignment = xlVAlignJustify
    Case 71
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.VerticalAlignment = xlVAlignDistributed
    Case 72
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.VerticalAlignment = 5
    Case 73
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 1
    Case 74
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 2
    Case 75
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 3
    Case 76
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 4
    Case 77
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 5
    Case 78
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 6
    Case 79
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 7
    Case 80
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = -4171
    Case 81
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = -4170
    Case 82
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = -4166
    Case 83
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = -4128
    Case 84
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalOverflow = xlOartHorizontalOverflowClip
    Case 85
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalOverflow = xlOartHorizontalOverflowOverflow
    Case 86
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalOverflow = 2
    Case 87
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.VerticalOverflow = xlOartVerticalOverflowClip
    Case 88
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.VerticalOverflow = xlOartVerticalOverflowEllipsis
    Case 89
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.VerticalOverflow = xlOartVerticalOverflowOverflow
    Case 90
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.VerticalOverflow = 3
    Case 91
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.ReadingOrder = xlRTL
    Case 92
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.ReadingOrder = xlLTR
    Case 93
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.ReadingOrder = xlContext
    Case 94
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.ReadingOrder = 5
    Case 95
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: s = tf.AutoMargins
    Case 96
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.AutoMargins = True: s = tf.AutoMargins
    Case 97
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = 7
    Case 98
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignCenter: tf.ReadingOrder = xlRTL
    Case 99
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.Orientation = 2: tf.Orientation = 1
    Case 100
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.ReadingOrder = xlRTL: tf.ReadingOrder = xlLTR
    Case 101
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.VerticalOverflow = xlOartVerticalOverflowOverflow: tf.MarginLeft = 10: tf.Orientation = 2: tf.VerticalAlignment = xlVAlignBottom: tf.HorizontalAlignment = xlHAlignCenter
    Case 102
        Set tf = ws.Shapes("T").TextFrame: tf.VerticalOverflow = xlOartVerticalOverflowOverflow: tf.VerticalOverflow = xlOartVerticalOverflowClip
    End Select
    For Each sh In ws.Shapes: Set tf = sh.TextFrame: s = s & "|" & sh.Name & "," & tf.MarginLeft & "," & tf.MarginTop & "," & tf.MarginRight & "," & tf.MarginBottom & "," & tf.HorizontalAlignment & "," & tf.VerticalAlignment & "," & tf.Orientation & "," & tf.HorizontalOverflow & "," & tf.VerticalOverflow & "," & tf.ReadingOrder: Next
    Tried = "ok " & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 102
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
